build_pybind11_sdist: build a pybind11 source distribution with substituted setup files and version verification
run_cmake_install_pybind11: run cmake to configure and install pybind11 headers into a local pybind11 directory
verify_pybind11_version_match: verify that the Python version matches the C++ version defined in common.h
create_temporary_directory_cleanup: create a temporary directory and automatically clean it up when done
remove_cmake_output_directories: remove pybind11 include and share directories after build completes
